title: Family Law
description: Divorce, property division, custody — decisions that shape the next several years. We explain the legal consequences in Chinese so you can see the actual choices, not just the emotion.
intro: Chinese families face three recurring difficulties in divorce: assets tied up in a family business, property held in one spouse's or a relative's name, and custody standards that differ sharply from expectations formed elsewhere. We start by mapping your assets and your children's situation, then explain what uncontested and contested paths would each cost in time and risk. (This is general information about how such matters usually proceed, not advice on your specific case. Where representation is needed, a licensed attorney at a partner law firm handles it.)
